messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['We have agreed that 25% of the total fund when remitted would be your share.', 'Your first payment has been approved.', 'All that is needed is for my lawyer to instruct the company to transfer the funds to your account, I will remunerate you with 20% at the end, but most of all is that I solicit your trust and honesty in this transaction.', 'WE RECEIVED THE INSTRUCTION LETTER TO CREDIT $10.5MILLION TO YOUR ACCOUNT.', 'I require urgently your unreserved assistance in providing me with a safe and reliable bank account with full details, where I can transfer the sum of $20.5M(Twenty million five hundred thousand United States of AmericanDollars)', "The charge for this order will appear on your credit card statement from the merchant 'AMZN Payment Services.'", 'Kindly get to me immediately, by furnishing me with your confidential phone number, fax number and exclusive bank particulars so that we can use these information to apply for the release and subsequent transfer of the funds in yourfavour.', 'Since then, I have made several inquiries to your Embassy to locate any of my clients extended relatives, but this was unsuccessful.', 'I wish to inform you that all necessary modalities have been automatically concluded, and the fund has to be moved by HSBC office through the Dial...']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
